claims.text: The OSG dataset was obtained by crawling and pre-processing an online support groups web forum.
The dataset consists of multi-threaded conversations from various support groups such as depression, anxiety, and relationship issues.
After de-duplication, the dataset contains 295 thousand conversations and 1.5 million comments.
